title: Note: design caveat - the front door and the ports

text: With the new plugin your dev server is the door for every <name>.localhost, so it is a dependency: while it restarts, the names are down (the :8090 and :8080 addresses still answer). And ports are hard-coded in several places (80, 8080, 8090, 8178, 8123) while Servex hands out free ports for projects - on another machine one could collide. Later: Servex assigns every port and everything else reads them from its registry. Noted, not now.
